errors.explanation: Keigo error: “だ” is at the wrong politeness level or uses honorific language the wrong way; the reference uses “です”. errors.explanation: Tense/aspect error: “作られた” should be “作られている”. In Japanese, た marks completion or the past and ている an ongoing action or resulting state; a verb before 前に takes the non-past and a verb before 後で takes the past, whatever the tense of the main clause.
